text:
olivia: Heads-up — eu-prod graphs show autoscaler flapping and a big tail latency spike. I'm putting the 1.42.0 rollout on hold for EU zones so we don't promote the canary.

deploybot: HOLD applied: release=1.42.0 scope=eu-prod reason=incident-2034 by=olivia :warning:

maria: ack. are we freezing just promotion or all deploys in eu?

olivia: hold is on promotion stage (no new traffic promos). We've paused the pipeline at canary -> region rollouts. No full rollback yet.

sam: do we want to rollback the canary pods? current errors are ingress 503s since 12:17 UTC.

ben: svc owner + ops here — recommend a soft rollback of canary to previous revision (1.41.7) and keep the rest frozen. Full rollback across the fleet seems risky until we confirm root cause.

maria: SGTM. how do we trigger the soft rollback? deploybot?

deploybot: To initiate soft rollback run:
```
deploy rollback --release 1.42.0 --to 1.41.7 --scope canary --reason "ingress 503s"
```

olivia: OK issuing soft rollback now, will post status updates. recheck in 20m then decide whether to lift hold.

sre-bot: Alert created: incident-2034 (ingress p99 spike). Dashboard: <https://grafana.redwood/s/shared/ingress|ingress-dash>

maria: i'm updating the release doc + changelog to note the hold and action taken. tagging support and release notes owners.

ben: pausing dependent scheduled jobs and backfills for 30m to avoid noisy signals.

olivia: update: rollback command executed, canary traffic shifted back to 1.41.7. preliminary metrics look better — p99 down. keeping hold until we confirm stability (+30m).

maria: noted, updating confluence: https://confluence.redwood/release/1.42.0 and adding rollback details + contact list.

olivia: thanks all — will re-evaluate at +30m or sooner if SRE flags anything. :thumbsup:
